# Tinlance SDEA

> Evidence-backed Signal-Driven Engineering Acquisition intelligence layer.

## Canonical description

SDEA converts observable organizational change into evidence-backed capability-demand intelligence and qualified acquisition opportunities. It sits between observation and commercial execution.

## Semantic boundaries

- signal != evidence
- evidence != demand
- demand != capability
- capability != opportunity
- opportunity != customer
- recommendation != action

SDEA does not own CRM, outreach, generic scraping, account enrichment, engineering execution, authorization, agent runtime or autonomous commercial action.

## Canonical pipeline

External world -> entity/event -> signal -> evidence/provenance -> normalization -> fusion -> temporal reasoning -> demand hypothesis -> capability need -> opportunity -> buying window -> acquisition recommendation -> human-approved action.

## Repository map

- `src/tinlance_sdea/domain/`: canonical domain contracts.
- `src/tinlance_sdea/entity/`: entity identity and ambiguity-safe resolution.
- `src/tinlance_sdea/evidence/`: evidence provenance and fingerprints.
- `src/tinlance_sdea/signals/`: signal taxonomy, normalization and deduplication.
- `src/tinlance_sdea/fusion/`: correlation and clustering.
- `src/tinlance_sdea/temporal/`: temporal reasoning and buying windows.
- `src/tinlance_sdea/epistemics/`: confidence, uncertainty and calibration.
- `src/tinlance_sdea/capability/`: capability ontology and mappings.
- `src/tinlance_sdea/inference/`: demand/capability inference abstractions.
- `src/tinlance_sdea/opportunity/`: opportunity intelligence and lifecycle.
- `src/tinlance_sdea/acquisition/`: advisory acquisition recommendations.
- `src/tinlance_sdea/outcomes/`: outcome and attribution primitives.
- `src/tinlance_sdea/evaluation/`: metrics, benchmarks and regression evaluation.
- `src/tinlance_sdea/contracts/`: versioned serialization/event contracts.
- `src/tinlance_sdea/governance/`: classification, retention and redaction primitives.
- `src/tinlance_sdea/observability/`: semantic event and trace contracts.
- `src/tinlance_sdea/policy/`: advisory recommendation-quality controls.
- `src/tinlance_sdea/integrations/`: downstream/upstream integration contracts.
- `docs/`: architecture, domain model, roadmap and ADRs.
- `deploy/`: first-stage Docker Compose deployment profile.

## Important implementation facts

- Python >= 3.12.
- Pydantic v2 models are immutable and reject unexpected fields.
- CI covers Python 3.12, 3.13 and 3.14.
- Coverage gate is 90%.
- The repository is proprietary software owned by Tinlance Limited.
